Admission.description: Whether state-writing runs require a CI deployment admission.

ApprovalIdentity.description: How Nyl learned an approver's identity. An audit record, not authorization.

oneOf.description: Read from the CI system, by a built-in lookup or the project's hook.
The Git user of a workstation run.

CommitId.description: A full, lowercase, 40-character Git commit ID.

DriftRepair.description:
Whether reconcile repairs drift on its own.

Contract: [Drift](../../../../design/orchestration-core.md#drift).

oneOf.description:
The next reconcile executes drifted units whose recovery policy is
`converge` again; a drifted unit that is not safe to re-run awaits
approval.

Reconcile repairs no drift by itself: drifted units stay `drifted`
until `nyl reconcile --unit <unit> --reapply --reason <text>`.

EnvironmentFrom.description:
One transition commit pair of the source environment, pushed together
with one `Nyl-Run-Id`.

observedCommit.description: Absent when the state has no observed commit of its own.

EnvironmentName.description:
An Environment's name, unique across declared Environments and all
template instances because leases, run refs, and keep refs are named
after it. A Kubernetes DNS label.

EnvironmentSource.description:
The source commit of an environment's runs: a ref whose tip each run uses,
optionally pinned to a commit that `nyl update source-locks` moves, or the
commit the newest promotion recorded.

commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase commit ID that is read, refreshed by `nyl update source-locks`.

fromPromotion.description: The source commit recorded by the newest promotion on a path; excludes the other fields.

repository.description: Inline repository coordinates to read from. Mutually exclusive with `repositoryRef`.

repositoryRef.description: Project-local `gitops.nyl/v1` GitRepository to read from. Mutually exclusive with inline `repository`.

revision.description: Human-readable branch or tag that `nyl update source-locks` resolves.

admission.description: CI deployment admission: `required` makes state-writing runs use the source of the current admission. Omitted, the group's, else `off`.

allowUnprotectedSource.description: Whether runs may use source commits outside `protectedRefs`. Omitted, the group's, else `false`.

attestations.description: Environment-wide attestations, recorded with `nyl attest` for the environment's current state.

driftRepair.description: Whether `reconcile` repairs drift by itself: `converge` executes units whose latest drift observation is `drifted` again (units not safe to re-run await approval); `manual` leaves them `drifted` until `--reapply`. Omitted, the group's, else `converge`.

protectedRefs.description: Refs that pinned commits and run source commits must be reachable from. Omitted, the group's, else each repository's default branch.

source.description: The source commit runs use. Omitted, the commit of the worktree a run starts from.

unitSelector.description: Matches literal unit `metadata.labels` across all unit kinds. An empty selector selects every unit.

values.description: Values unit templates see as `values`, merged recursively over the values of the EnvironmentGroup selecting this environment.

EnvironmentState.description: The location of an environment's state: a repository and the refs within it.

admissionRef.description: Ref of the deployment admission record. Default the desired ref.

coordinationRefPrefix.description: Prefix, ending in `/`, of the leases, runs, and signals refs. Default `refs/nyl/`.

desiredRef.description: Ref of the desired state. A short name is a branch. Default `nyl/<environment>/desired`.

observedRef.description: Ref of the observed state; may equal `desiredRef`. Default `nyl/<environment>/observed`.

path.description: Directory of the environment's state within its refs, so several environments can share one ref. Default the root.

repository.description: Inline repository coordinates holding the state. Mutually exclusive with `repositoryRef`.

repositoryRef.description: GitRepository holding the state, read through its `repoURL` and written through its `publishURL`. Mutually exclusive with `repository`. Omitted with `repository`: the group's, else the checkout's `origin`, else the local repository.

EvidenceAttestation.description: An attestation a promotion relied on.

details.description: The driver's details, such as each Application's running publication and health.

EvidenceLevel.description: The level a promotion's evidence reached.

ExecutionKey.description:
A digest of everything that decides what a unit's execution does:
`sha256:` and 64 lowercase hex digits.

GitOpsResourceMetadata.description: Metadata shared by local GitOps compiler resources.

labels.description: Literal labels used for organization and target selection.

name.description: Project-local identity, validated by the resource kind; remains static during discovery.

publishURL.description: Optional Git write URL. Publication uses `repoURL` when omitted.

repoURL.description: Credential-free Git read URL used by renderers and generated Applications.

matchLabels.description: Exact label matches, combined with AND. An empty map selects every ApplicationGroup.

name.description: Project-local name of the referenced resource; its kind and API group are determined by the containing field.

PromotedSource.description: A source that promotion paths supply.

path.description: The PromotionPath that supplies the source. Mutually exclusive with `paths`.

paths.description: Several PromotionPaths; the newest record on any of them wins. Mutually exclusive with `path`.

promoted.description: The PromotionRecord `nyl promote` writes here with `record: source`, never by hand. It has the shape of the record in state, without `apiVersion` and `kind`.

PromotedState.description:
The state a value-only path took one value from, when that is not the
record's `from`.

PromotedUnit.description: The identity of the source unit a value came from.

uid.description: The incarnation; absent when the unit had none in the recorded state.

PromotedValue.description: One promoted value with its lineage.

executionKey.description: The receipt the value came from, for an output or artifact selector.

inputDigest.description: The digest of the unit's resolved input, for an `input` selector.

state.description: Present when a value-only path took the value from another state than `from`.

unit.description: The source unit; absent for a target source's value (M11) and when unknown.

PromotionEvidence.description: The evidence a promotion rested on.

override.description: Written as `null` when the promotion needed no override.

PromotionFrom.description:
The source state a record promotes: an environment's, or (M11, never
written by M6) a DeploymentTarget's publication commit.

PromotionPathName.description:
A PromotionPath's `metadata.name`, which names its record file
`desired/promotions/<path>.yaml`. A Kubernetes DNS label.

PromotionRecord.description:
What `nyl promote` records about one promotion on one path.

Each promotion replaces the path's record; Git history keeps earlier ones.
In an Environment's `source.fromPromotion.promoted` block it stands alone;
in state it is a [`PromotionRecordDocument`].

from.description: The source state; for a path that promotes only values, the newest state any value came from.

path.description: The PromotionPath that wrote the record.

sequence.description: Increases with every promotion into the target environment, on any path; the highest is the newest.

sourceCommit.description: The source commit of that state, present when the path promotes the target's source or a value's lineage includes one.

PromotionRequest.description: Who asked for the promotion, recorded like an approval.

PromotionSelect.description:
Which field of the source a promoted value reads: the same selectors, with
the same JSON Pointer semantics and resolver, as `fromUnit` references and
`nyl get`.

Set exactly one of the four forms:
`{unit, input}` reads the source unit's resolved spec;
`{unit, output, pointer?}` a declared, non-sensitive output of its receipt;
`{unit, artifact, kind?, pointer}` a field of an artifact its receipt lists,
relative to the artifact's `spec`; and `{input}` (a target source, M11)
a Release input of the target.

artifact.description: An artifact the unit's receipt lists.

input.description: JSON Pointer into the source unit's resolved spec, such as `/source` or `/releases/platform~1web/image`.

kind.description: The artifact kind the artifact must have.

output.description: A declared, non-sensitive output of the unit's receipt.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer inside the output, or inside the artifact's `spec`.

ReadGitRepository.description: Credential-free coordinates for a repository that is only read.

repoURL.description: Git read URL. Source checkouts never publish to this repository.

RunId.description: The UUID of one run, recorded in the `Nyl-Run-Id` trailer.

repository.description: The repository of the commit, such as a unit's source repository.

TargetFrom.description: A target source: the publication commit the values came from. Reserved for M11.

Uid.description:
The UUIDv7 of one incarnation of a unit. It fences every receipt,
checkpoint, and deletion.

UnitName.description:
A unit's literal `metadata.name`, unique per environment across all
unit kinds. A Kubernetes DNS label.

description:
A named place that units are reconciled into, with its own state.

An Environment selects units by their literal labels and gives their
templates its `values`. The selected, enabled units are its ownership set:
a unit that leaves the set is deleted under its deletion policy.

## When needed

To reconcile units with `nyl reconcile -e <environment>`.

## If omitted

No orchestration happens; rendering and publication work as before.
